text_block_list.text:
—On that very day, after safely finishing 
the debut race. We were already deciding 
on the next target race.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. There are so many races, I can't 
really tell what's what!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really not good at thinking things 
through, y'know~ Hmmmmm!"

Winning Ticket stares intently at 
technical books and past data. She's 
giving it her all, but she seems to be 
having a tough time.
choice_data_list:
(As their Trainer, I've got to do my 
best!)

(As their Trainer, I've got to do my 
best!)

text_block_list.text:
...And bracing myself once more, I set out 
to create the rotation scheduleâ

If we're aiming for the Japan Derby, you 
should first get used to longer distance 
races.

Thinking about it like that—how about the 
Hopeful Stakes, the longest-distance GⅠ 
race in the Junior Class?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"The Hopeful Stakes!? Oooohh!! It's a G1 
race! Sounds like fun!"
choice_data_list: Give it your all and get a great result!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah-h-h!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Heheheh, man, this really feels like 
the Twinkle Series~~~!!

—And with that, the days of training hard 
for the Hopeful Stakes began!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "WOOOOOOOOO~!! Number seveeeeeeennnnn~!!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
HOOOOOOOPEFUUUUUUUL~~! 
STAAAAAAA~~~KEEESSSSS!!!

Muster every ounce of strength, Winning 
Ticket charges up the slope.

On the track, I could also see her fellow 
Japanese Derby contenders, Narita Taishin 
and Biwa Hayahide, putting in laps just 
like she was.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hah...!

—Biwa Hayahide aims for even greater 
heights in the time trial.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...!

—Narita Taishin pushes herself to the 
limit with buildup running.

As if competing against one another, they 
all set their sights on the Japanese 
Derby...!

One evening, after days like that had 
continued.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant*...! Pheeewwwwwww...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, how was it?! Trainer!

To assess her current capabilities, I've 
been clocking her daily times over 2,000 
meters on turf, the same distance as the 
Hopeful Stakes, but—
The results hadn't been very good.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eeeh~~~~?! Even after all this training?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Why, why, why!? I'm trying my best out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, having troubles on your mind for once, 
Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hayahideee! It's a big worry, all right! A 
super huge worry!

As a close friend of Winning Ticket, Biwa 
Hayahide might know something.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Struggling to improve your time, huh? I 
see."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I'm just not trying hard 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...If you'd like, wanna try running a mock 
race?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of whether it solves anything— 
it might be a good change of pace. Since 
we have the chance, shall we invite 
Taishin too?

—And so, the three of us ended up running 
an impromptu mock race.

In the sunset glow, the sound of the gate 
opening rang out. The moment the three 
dashed out, I pressed the stopwatch in my 
hand.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Then, as usual...!

Leading the pack is Biwa Hayahide, with 
Winning Ticket and Narita Taishin 
following in pursuit.

The pack eventually passed the 4th 
corner... and as they entered the final 
straight—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Right here!

Narita Taishin launched her final spurt, 
overtaking Biwa Hayahide in the blink of 
an eye!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...! You've built up quite a lot of 
stamina, Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nghhh...! I can do it toooo!

A fierce battle of overtaking and being 
overtaken continued— With 100 meters to 
go, she screamed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!! I won't lose, I won't 
lose, I won't loooose--!!

Kicking off the dirt, swinging my arms, 
just to get there even one step faster—

—With fierce determination gleaming in the 
eyes of all three, they lunged across the 
finish line almost simultaneously!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Haa..., haa...! Ahhh~~~, man, I'm totally 
exhausted~~!

To everyone's surprise, the result was a 
dead heat.

Winning Ticket returned to her usual self 
after finishing the run... but the sheer 
intensity she showed earlier was 
unforgettable.

Indeed, looking down at the stopwatch... a 
new personal best time was recorded!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh!? A new personal best!? 
Yaaaaaaaay~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, incredible, sooo cool! I 
wonder what suddenly got into her~~~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing complicated. Her rivalry 
against us simply stimulated her muscles.

"Whaaaaaaaah!! I won't lose, I won't lose, 
I won't loooose!!"

Winning Ticket's sheer obsession with 
victory that she displayed during the mock 
race—

Had there ever been another training 
session where she pursued victory with 
such sheer desperation?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Hayahide! You're totally 
right! The sound of their footsteps made 
my heart pound like crazy!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"And then, from the bottom of my belly, I 
went like, 'WOOOOAAAAHHH!'"

To Winning Ticket, having "rivals" seems 
to mean more than I ever imagined.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Hayahideee! I finally beat my 
record!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If I was able to aid in your growth, 
then I am glad.

Seeing her serene smile, a certain 
possibility comes to mind.
choice_data_list: Did you know that when you raced?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No. It's not like I had absolute 
certainty. It's just that I tend to have 
those tendencies myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I only suggested it thinking maybe Ticket 
could as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"...You're pretty relaxed, Hayahide. 
Helping out the competition like that."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They're an important rival. If they need 
help, I'll send salt, rice, whatever it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eh!? Hayahide, you're giving me rice!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's just a figure of speech, idiot.

The impromptu mock race came to an end in 
a warm and friendly atmosphere.

"Rivals." To her, that might just be the 
single most important element in rising 
through the Twinkle Series.
